note: Failures the app has today that the commit adding the case does not fix. Each prints on every run and does not fail the run. A known failure that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a fix is never merged without its entry coming off this list. An entry matches a case id exactly through `case`, or by a regular expression through `match` when one finding shows up under several case ids.

failures.shows: A build made without REACT_APP_PORTAL_URL holds https://ocsa-staff-portal.vercel.app, and Help reads the staff app pictures from it.
failures.why: clientConfig defaults the staff app address to the Vercel address; contract 2.6 says no link is built on it. The default should be https://staff.ocsaco.com.

failures.shows: A supervisor opening a person in Staff Management reads Hourly Rate on the profile card (Not set once the API leaves the rate out) and Print Report prints an Hourly Rate line.
failures.why: Neither the card nor the print is gated by manage_employment, which holds every pay figure (contract 1 and 2.1); the role and hire date beside them are.

failures.shows: A supervisor who changes nothing and presses Save Changes on a profile sends hourlyRate "" with every other field of the form; the window also offers an Hourly Rate box.
failures.why: saveProfileInfo sends the whole form (contract 2.2), and the form loads hourlyRate as "" when the profile answer carries none, as the API as built answers a supervisor. The list pencil was made diff-only in #101; this editor was not.

failures.shows: Every profile a supervisor opens draws the API refusal (Insufficient permissions) where the employment history card goes.
failures.why: Staff Management reads GET /api/users/:id/employment for everyone; contract 1 puts the employment history card under read_hr_records.

failures.shows: A supervisor at #hr/signatures reads This page is for admins.; signature notices tell them That one is for admins.
failures.why: Waiting for signatures is only a tab of HR Records, which closes when the API answers read_hr_records false, and only #hr/training is let through. Contract 1 keeps Waiting for signatures with supervisors.

failures.shows: A supervisor pressing a row on Clearances lands on #hr/<id>/clearances and reads This page is for admins.
failures.why: Recording and correcting clearance dates lives only in the HR folder, which read_hr_records closes. Contract 1 keeps clearance status and dates with supervisors.

failures.shows: Discipline offers a supervisor no Issue a warning; the only ways in are the HR folder (closed to them) and a case.
failures.why: Issue a warning is drawn in PersonDiscipline inside the HR folder alone. Contract 1 keeps Discipline with supervisors.

failures.shows: A task_assigned, training_assigned, training_session, site_assigned, workspace_member or document_to_sign notice opens the staff app in a new tab from the bell, and the front page from an alert.
failures.why: noticePlace and the service worker placeOf have no place for the six types API #146 added, so the notice link decides; contract 2.6 says a tap opens the item in the app the reader uses, never a sign-in.

failures.shows: A support ticket notice opens Tickets from the bell (through its link) and the front page from an alert, and no address opens the ticket itself.
failures.why: Neither noticePlace nor placeOf knows support_ticket or support_ticket_new, and TicketsPage takes no route.

failures.shows: A shift_drop or shift_claim notice opens this week on Schedule with nothing open; the request is decided on Shift Pickup or from the shift in its own week.
failures.why: noticePlace sends every shift_* subject to #schedule.

failures.shows: A notice of a type the dashboard does not know, with no link, closes the bell and is marked read, and nothing opens and nothing is said.
failures.why: goToNotice falls through to notifTarget, which answers none for no link and does nothing.

failures.shows: Printing a person timeline or a Record Detail writes an issue title typed in the staff app into the print window as markup.
failures.why: Seven print builders (Staff and Sites timelines and record details, the staff profile print, the inspections print) concatenate API text into HTML with no escaping and document.write it into a window on the dashboard origin, where the session token is kept in localStorage.

failures.shows: A double press on Schedule Shift sends two POST /api/schedule, so the person holds the same shift twice.
failures.why: submitCreate has no busy flag or ref and the button is never disabled.

failures.shows: A site whose last inspection the API sends as 2026-03-10 reads Mar 9 on its Shifts tab.
failures.why: fd() parses a date-only value as UTC midnight and draws it in the browser zone, the day before.

failures.shows: At 9:30 PM in New York, on a browser set to UTC, Log training for several people starts on 2026-03-18 where the company day is 2026-03-17.
failures.why: todayISO and toISO(new Date()) read the browser clock; nothing in src reads clientConfig.company.timeZone for today.

failures.shows: Add equipment on a 390 phone at Standard text, and on a 1024 laptop at the Largest size, puts Save below the window bottom with no scroller in the window; the wheel does not move it.
failures.why: Mdl gives a tall window the screen height with overflow hidden, and Add equipment, Issue PPE, the Warning window, Issue property and a Workspace post draw no scroller of their own.

failures.shows: 20 windows added since the full audit was paused on Sept 28 have no case in the windows suite; the smoke check opens each of them: EmploymentWindow, BlockWindowWindow, RequestWindow, SupplyRequestWindow, TicketWindow, TicketsExportWindow, HolidaysPanel, LinkQrWindow, OpenCaseWindow, TrainingTopicWindow, PersonTrainingWindow, UploadCertificateWindow, AssignTrainingWindow, SignOffWindow, SignHereWindow, SignatureRequestWindow, IssuePropertyWindow, ReturnPropertyWindow, TurnOffLinkWindow, TrainingMatrix.

failures.where: audit/inventory.js WINDOWS, audit/cases/windows.js ROUTES; the windows are named with their lines by the coverage rows

failures.shows: Ten pages in PAGE_IDS have no entry in the inventory, so the pages suite never opens them: workspace, tickets, quotes, periodic, owner, library, equipment, discipline, clearances, chat-records.
failures.why: Added since Sept 28 (Steps 208 to 306) while the full audit was paused; the smoke check opens every side panel item instead.

failures.shows: Eleven pages have no view case: the ten above and Training.
failures.why: The views suite claims tabs and sub-screens page by page; none was written for these.

failures.shows: 22 pairs in the word table have no row in the CSV, and 40 CSV rows have no pair in the table.
failures.why: 40 rows of the CSV write the English with its context after the bar (Valid until|quote), where the comparer and the other context keys write it without. The Spanish agrees in all 40.
failures.where: translation/dashboard_words.csv (the 40 rows are listed in audit/FINDINGS_2026-10.md, Appendix: words); audit/lib/words.js

failures.shows: The finder names 18 printed pages where src/App.js holds 20 page openings.
failures.why: Three of the 20 are the error page a print writes in its catch when its read fails (printTrainingAttempt, printSessionRoster, printDocumentSignatures), and two of those sit in a function that already opens its page, so a plain count of openings is 2 over the finder's count of printing functions. No printed page is missed.

failures.shows: The source finder counts 83 strings on pages taken as done as English.
failures.why: 72 of the 83 are keys the word table holds Spanish for, translated where they are used in shapes the finder does not follow (a list walked with .map(c => ({ l: tr(c.l) })), a table read through a helper); the other 11 are CSS, a query string, an SVG, a document code and a language's own name. The Spanish screen pass reads these pages with no English left.
failures.where: audit/lib/strings.js translatedShapes; the strings are listed in audit/FINDINGS_2026-10.md
